title: Sign Encoding Preserves Relative Distance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{F}_2$. Encoding each value by its sign preserves relative Hamming distance: the relative Hamming distance between the encoded functions equals that between $f$ and $g$.
